senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; v. בָּקַר) a beef; (collect.) oxen, cattle. Sifra Vayikra ch. II, Par. 2 אין לך בבהמה אלא ב׳ וכ׳ under b’hemah for offerings (Lev. I, 2) are meant only beeves and sheep; a. fr. בן ב׳ young cattle, calf.
units: Ib.; a. fr.—רועי ב׳ herders (suspected of feeding upon other people’s fields).
<cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 3:2">Snh. III, 2</cite> <he>נאמנין עלי שלשה ר׳ ב׳</he> (if one says) I have faith in (the arbitration of) three herders.
